title: Grimoire Archive: Important Systems
summary: Read archive states, bridge records, forbidden pages, and Terminal presentation rules.

blocks.title: Archive States
blocks.body: Entries can be visible, locked, active, bridge-generated, scanned, or forbidden. Each state changes how much certainty the player should have.

blocks.title: Bridge Records
blocks.body: Generated Veilbound, relic, ritual, spell, and curse records let the archive explain optional systems without directly owning them.

blocks.title: Forbidden Pages
blocks.body: Forbidden entries should warn before they tempt. If a page only says power is cool, it is not doing Grimoire work.

blocks.title: State Check
blocks.body: Use the system note to read the current state, then choose one action that answers it.
